estimator: OLS with HC3 covariance and two-sided t inference
multiplicity: Report raw HC3 p and Holm within the two primary or six secondary interactions; no selection decisions
continuous_predictors: Mean-center, retain original units; no dichotomization
missing: Stop; never drop or impute frozen participants
scoring_requirement: Final results require item-to-total checks; user-authorized provisional runs may use the complete exported totals while verification is pending
interpretation: Cross-sectional conditional associations, not causality, mediation or prospective prediction
timing: Behavioral model family specified after the neural analyses; not preregistered
